subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>; Ben Rogers <ben.rogers@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to get the POC moving.

Pain points you called out:
- High latency and cost on current generation models for customer-facing search answers (95th pct latency spikes up to ~1.2s).
- Inconsistent answer quality on long-tail queries (many hallucinations on product details).
- Need for predictable cost per 1k queries for the Q3 roadmap.

Goals for the POC:
- Reduce 95th pct latency to <350ms for single-turn queries under expected load.
- Achieve >= 92% accuracy on our prompt evaluation set (we'll validate with your 500-case prompt set).
- Demonstrate cost reduction of >= 30% per 1k tokens vs current baseline with batching + quantization.

Proposed POC scope (high level):
- Duration: 6 weeks (kickoff next week)
- Workstreams: data & access, prompt set & evals, runtime tuning (batching, quant), rollout plan
- Owners: Marissa (program lead), Rishi (solutions/engineer), Neha (account manager)

Immediate asks for kickoff:
1) Access: API keys for a staging dataset + 500-case prompt CSV (please share by EOD Tue).
2) Success metrics: confirm the evaluation rubric (latency percentiles, accuracy definition).
3) Stakeholders: please confirm who from your engineering and product teams will be involved.

Attachments: draft SOW (ACME-POC-SOW-v1.pdf), example prompt set (acme_prompt_set.csv).

Proposed kickoff meeting: Wednesday 2027-04-21 10:00am PT — 45 mins (agenda: alignment, access, runbook).

If that all looks right I can send a formal kickoff invite + SOW for signature.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0178

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Rogers <ben.rogers@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Thanks, Marissa — this is perfect and captures everything we discussed. A few clarifications: 

- Accuracy definition: we'll use exact-match + tolerant semantic match (our product team will provide the rubric).
- Dataset: we'll share a redacted staging dataset and the 500-case prompt CSV by EOD Tuesday (2027-04-20). Expect two people from Eng (Ben and Sarah Park) to be on the kickoff.
- Timeline: 6 weeks works; one request — can we aim to have a mid-POC checkpoint at week 3 for a performance and cost readout?

Also, on security: we'll need a short questionnaire (SOC2 scoping) completed before we onboard production data. Is that something you can attach?

Agree to kickoff Wed 4/21 10am PT — Ben and I will be there. Please send the invite.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Product | Acme Corp
alice.chen@acme.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Alice — quick note on technical onboarding items so we can hit the proposed metrics: 

1) Access & creds: we'll need a staging API key (scoped) and an S3 location or equivalent for the redacted dataset. If you prefer, we can provision a temporary dedicated bucket during the POC.
2) Baseline measurement: please share a small sample of current latency traces (p95/p99), and a cost baseline (USD per 1k tokens) so we can compute delta.
3) Prompt set & eval harness: we'll run your 500-case prompt CSV through our evaluation harness; if you can attach the rubric (as Alice mentioned) we'll align on scoring.
4) Security: we can complete a scoped SOC2 questionnaire for the POC; Marissa/Neha will attach the questionnaire and a list of minimal evidence items we need.

I'll prepare the initial runtime config (batching targets, quant profile) and share before kickoff so we can review in the meeting.

Cheers,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>; Ben Rogers <ben.rogers@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff Plan & Runbook (attached)

Thanks for the quick replies — attaching the items Rishi and I discussed. Summary of the kickoff plan and who does what: 

Scope: 6-week POC focused on search-answer latency and accuracy on your 500-case prompt set.
Success metrics (final):
- p95 latency < 350ms (under target concurrency)
- Accuracy >= 92% on supplied rubric
- Cost savings >= 30% per 1k tokens vs baseline

Owners & responsibilities:
- Marissa Cole (program lead): overall coordination, SOW & procurement
- Neha Kapoor (account manager): invoicing, vendor access, procurement questions
- Rishi Malhotra (SE): runtime config, quantization, eval harness setup
- Alice Chen / Ben Rogers (Acme): staging dataset, rubric, eng support for traces

Timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): contract & questionnaire signed; creds & prompt CSV received
- Week 1: onboarding & smoke tests; baseline capture
- Weeks 2–4: tuning runs (batching, quantization, prompt engineering) + weekly checkpoints
- Week 3: mid-POC performance & cost checkpoint (deliverable: short readout deck)
- Week 5: final evaluation runs and regression checks
- Week 6: wrap, results deck, recommendation + optional follow-on proposal

Prompt set & evals: we will run your 500-case prompt set against the baseline and 2 candidate configs. We’ll produce per-prompt scoring and a pass/fail summary. Please see acme_prompt_set.csv for format.

Access & onboarding steps (for your eng team):
1) Provide a scoped staging API key or approve our temporary bucket access (S3).
2) Share p95/p99 traces and cost baseline CSV.
3) Add rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai to your Jira board or provide an initial ticket with access issues.

Attachments included: ACME-POC-SOW-v1.pdf (SOW + payment terms), acme_prompt_set.csv (template), SOC2-questionnaire-poc.pdf (scoping).

Next steps:
- Marissa to send DocuSign SOW by EOD today.
- Alice to share prompt CSV + baseline traces by EOD Tue (2027-04-20).
- Kickoff meeting invite to go out for Wed 4/21 10am PT.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0178
